reasons: Both answers make essentially the same recommendations: strict JSON-schema Structured Outputs with enums, a note that the schema does not control the language of reason, a single English-ticket few-shot example rather than 2-3, a Cyrillic check in code, the 0.94^5 ≈ 73% argument, and a 100-200 ticket golden set with automated metrics. B is slightly more concrete: it gives the full API call, explains why json_object mode is not enough, and lists specific checks. A adds prompt-injection tagging and borderline tickets in the test set. The differences roughly cancel out.
